reports.title: The Model Trap: Exposing Jeffrey Epstein's Network - BBC World Service Documentaries
reports.description:
#BBCEye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences.

Click here to subscribe to our channel 👉🏽 https://bbc.in/3VyyriM

Over the course of a year, BBC Eye carried out a forensic examination of more than three million pages released by the US Department of Justice [DOJ] and spoke to more than 100 models from 14 countries. Many of whom shared their stories with us for the first time.

Through their testimony and the DOJ files, we reveal new details about the mechanisms of Epstein’s global operation - the heart of which was an international scouting network - and how, after his conviction, his attention increasingly turned to young women from Eastern Europe and Russia.

reports.title: Catching My Teacher – BBC World Service Documentaries
reports.description:
Two former students lift the lid on alleged sexual abuse and cover-ups at Islamic boarding schools in Indonesia. #BBCEye tracks down those accused and investigates how powerful institutions helped them evade justice.

Subscribe to our channel: 👉🏽 https://bbc.in/3VyyriM

In Indonesia, millions of parents send their children to Islamic boarding schools. But former students say sexual abuse can remain hidden behind the authority and influence of religious leaders.

This investigation follows two women who speak publicly for the first time about their experiences as students, and examines allegations that politically influential institutions sought to silence them and protect those accused.

Sukma, who graduated in December 2025 on Lombok island, near Bali, says she was abused by her headteacher. She discovers secret recordings in which he pushes students to lie and pretend all the evidence against him was made up. Wearing a hidden camera provided by the BBC, Sukma attempts to confront him.

Ira, who studied in East Java, says she was sadistically abused over several years by the son of the school’s founder. He has never been charged in relation to her allegations, but was convicted of sexually abusing another student and sentenced to seven years in prison. BBC undercover reporters track him down and reveal he has been secretly released early.

🎥 Watch this documentary in Indonesian here: https://youtu.be/hop_rtjHI8g

reports.title: The curse of the Chinese blessing scam - BBC Trending, BBC World Service
reports.description:
Female criminals are exploiting superstition and family love to swindle women with Chinese heritage living in the west. Now a social media activist is fighting back.

The blessing scam is an elaborate piece of criminal street theatre which in the last few months has claimed victims across North America as well as Australia and the UK.

It begins with an apparently random meeting with a stranger in the street, and very quickly escalates from there. 

Victims are tricked out of their money and possessions after being terrified into believing that a relative’s life is threatened by evil spirits. And they’re left wondering: how did that happen? Are the criminals just master manipulators, or could something even more sinister be involved?

reports.title: Like, Follow, Trafficked: Insta’s Fake Guru - BBC World Service Documentaries
reports.description:
#BBCEye Investigations and #BBCNewsBrasil uncover the truth behind the rise of wellness influencer and spiritual life coach, Kat Torres, and the international search for her trafficked followers.

Click here to subscribe to our channel 👉🏽 https://bbc.in/3VyyriM

Former Brazilian model, wellness influencer and spiritual life coach Kat Torres was an inspiration and a lifeline to women all over the world. More than a million people on Instagram followed her extraordinary career trajectory from extreme poverty in Brazil, to a European modelling career and a life of luxury in the US.   
 
But behind the perfectly curated posts is a story of witchcraft, exploitation and human trafficking - a dark and secretive sorority that led to missing women and sent their families and the FBI on a desperate search to find them.
 
After months of investigations, a team from #BBCEye and https://www.youtube.com/user/BBCBrasil uncover a wellness empire built on half-truths and lies. This film tells the story of her enslaved followers and the heavy price they paid. And for the first time - in a surreal confrontation behind the walls of a Brazilian prison - we hear from the self-proclaimed “guru” who exerted absolute control.

🎞️ To watch more investigative journalism from our award-winning BBC Eye team check out this documentary playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLz_B0PFGIn4fADt3h_U2SOWErIq-xtXPD
